A.notes: Features an ambitious scroll transition where the hero cup scales and pins to become the product image, which is a great idea. However, the site suffers from layout repetition (the hero and featured product sections feel redundant) and fails the accessibility hard gate due to low-contrast body text in the dark bands.

B.notes: Executes the brief flawlessly with a highly polished editorial design. The typography is elegant and establishes a strong identity, while the CSS/SVG illustrations are beautifully crafted. Motion is subtle (mainly the timeline filling on scroll), but the overall execution is flawless and accessible.

raw.why: Site B offers a pixel-perfect, highly accessible editorial layout with excellent typography, whereas Site A fails the contrast hard gate.
